_source: Recorded by `bun run explain:probe:import-dry-run 7.24.5` (scripts/probes/explain-import-dry-run.ts) on stock CHR 7.24.5 x86, 2026-10-31, replicated on a second full-matrix pass with identical outcomes. One disposable quickchr CHR per import run, destroyed after; uploads were verbatim bytes. Re-run that command to reproduce; per-run captures stay in `.scratch/`. Docs consulted first: RouterOS manual Scripting#import (verbose=yes dry-run, #line echo, error summary). No router is needed to read this file.

files.name: good.rsc
files.intent: two valid adds; plain/verbose must apply both, dry-run must apply neither
files.input:
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.1/32 comment=probe-520-a
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=198.51.100.7/32 comment=probe-520-b

files.name: mixed.rsc
files.intent: valid, bad command, valid; fail-fast shape, error multiplicity and coordinates
files.input:
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.9/32 comment=probe-520-c
this is not a command
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=203.0.113.4/32 comment=probe-520-d

files.name: side-fx.rsc
files.intent: harmless observable controls for what dry-run executes vs skips: identity rename plus one add
files.input:
/system identity set name=probe-520-side-fx
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.99/32 comment=probe-520-e

highlight.input: /ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.1/32 comment=probe-520-a
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=198.51.100.7/32 comment=probe-520-b

mixed.rsc.parseOutput: (evl /ip/firewall/address-list/addaddress=192.0.2.9/32;comment=probe-520-c;list=probe-520);(<%% bad command name this (line 2 column 1) this;is;not;a;command);(evl /ip/firewall/address-list/addaddress=203.0.113.4/32;comment=probe-520-d;list=probe-520)

highlight.input: /ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.9/32 comment=probe-520-c
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=203.0.113.4/32 comment=probe-520-d
/ip firewall address-list add list=probe-520 address=192.0.2.99/32 comment=probe-520-e

findings: dry-run executes nothing: good.rsc reports `No syntax errors found in the import file` with empty state; side-fx.rsc leaves identity `CHR` and creates no entries.
verbose=yes alone APPLIES the import (entries created, identity renamed) — verbose is output detail, not a dry run.
plain and verbose imports are fail-fast: mixed.rsc stops at `bad command name this (line 2 column 1)` having applied only line 1; line 3 never runs.
dry-run scans the whole file and counts: mixed.rsc echoes all three `#line` blocks then `Script Error: found 1 error(s) in import file`; plain/verbose stop at the first error with no count.
coordinates travel with the error in every mode: `bad command name this (line 2 column 1)`.
cost on this lab: uploads ~180-1600ms on first touch, probes 2-8ms, imports 14-22ms; captures are per-run JSON in `.scratch/`.
